gloss: to mourn; to hold a memorial service; to pay one's respects to the dead

definitions.gloss: to mourn; to hold a memorial service; to console the spirit of the deceased
definitions.explanation: To express grief for the dead and perform rituals or acts to honor their memory. Encompasses both the emotional aspect of mourning and the religious/ceremonial aspect of memorial services.

examples.japanese: {亡|な}くなった{友人|ゆうじん}を{弔|とむら}う。
{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}の{霊|れい}を{弔|とむら}う{式典|しきてん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A ceremony was held to honor the spirits of the war dead.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}を{手向|たむ}けて{故人|こじん}を{弔|とむら}い、{静|しず}かに{祈|いの}りを{捧|ささ}げた。
examples.english: We offered flowers to mourn the deceased and quietly offered our prayers.

notes:
A godan verb (u-row conjugation: {弔|とむら}わない, {弔|とむら}って). The word carries a solemn, respectful tone and is used in formal and literary contexts about death and memorial. In everyday speech, {冥福|めいふく}を{祈|いの}る (to pray for someone's rest in peace) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死者|ししゃ}を{弔|とむら}う: to mourn the dead
- {霊|れい}を{弔|とむら}う: to console a spirit
- {弔|とむら}いの{言葉|ことば}: words of condolence
- {弔|とむら}い{合戦|がっせん}: a battle fought to avenge the dead

RELATED TERMS:
- {弔辞|ちょうじ}: funeral address, eulogy
- {弔電|ちょうでん}: condolence telegram
- {弔問|ちょうもん}: condolence visit
- {追悼|ついとう}: memorial, commemoration

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {弔|とむら}っていませんでした
